name: SpecStream
description: SpecStream is the live web data engine for teams and agents. Deep Search turns a request in plain words into structured rows from the live web: every match found, extracted and enriched into structured records, then monitored for change. It also enriches a list you have. Source URL and read time on every value. The most a run can cost is shown and approved before it runs, only delivered rows are billed at 5 cents, 15 cents or $1 a row, and a run that finds nothing costs nothing. Remote MCP with OAuth.
author: SpecStream SAS

prompts.name: find_data
prompts.title: Find live web data
prompts.description: Describe the records you need and get them from the live web, with the source URL and read time on every value.

arguments.name: request
arguments.description: What you need, in plain words. For example: dental clinics in Austin with the owner's name and phone number.

arguments.name: budget
arguments.description: The most you want to spend, such as $20.

prompts.name: enrich_records
prompts.title: Add facts to my records
prompts.description: Bring in your own companies, people or places and fill in what's missing from the live web.

arguments.name: records
arguments.description: Your records: pasted rows, a CSV, or a link to a Google Sheet, Excel workbook or Airtable view.

arguments.name: facts
arguments.description: The facts to add. For example: website, headcount and the CEO's email.

prompts.name: keep_current
prompts.title: Keep data current
prompts.description: Run a request on a schedule and get the new and changed records where you work.

arguments.name: request
arguments.description: What to watch, in plain words. For example: new restaurant permits in Miami.

arguments.name: how_often
arguments.description: How often to check, such as every weekday at 9:00.

arguments.name: send_to
arguments.description: Where new and changed records go: notifications, a Slack channel, a connected tool or a webhook.
